newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Sept 24.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
* Republican Congressional leaders agreed to drop from the pending immigration bill a provision that would have barred the children of illegal immigrants from enrolling in school.
* President Clinton signed a $256.6 billion spending bill that gives $11.2 billion more for defense spending than he requested.
* Reform Party presidential candidate Ross Perot filed a lawsuit in federal court that seeks to overturn his exclusion from presidential debates.
* Despite the world class attention being given to President Boris Yeltsin, Russian heart patients typically suffer substandard care.
* Sending students to school year-round, something being considered in New York City, has been slow to gain acceptance in Los Angeles.
* Newspapers in North Carolina have banded together to run articles that focus on the same issues in an effort to set political agendas.
* Legendary mathmetician Paul Erdos died Friday in Warsaw at the age of 83.
* Kuwait is finding self-reliance an elusive goal, as the country's more menial jobs are snubbed by nationals and filled by foreigners, and its self-defense is overseen by outsiders.
* A suspected member of the Irish Republican Army was shot dead, five other men arrested and a cache of weapons and explosives uncovered in London raids.
